snippet.title: Nintendo 64 Longplay [007] Star Soldier: Vanishing Earth
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: NPI

The N64 version of the Star Soldier series, the series are mostly known on the Turbografx.

00:01:43 2 Minutes Mode
00:04:22 5 Minutes Mode
00:09:36 Normal Mode, got the good ending (medium difficulty, worst spaceship, wasn't easy at all!)
00:49:48 Secret Missions 1, 2 and 3 (which you access through Missions 2, 3 and 4)
01:08:41 Bad Ending (in the normal mode) if you don't beat the final boss in 2 minutes! -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
